title: The Vetting of the Cabinet — August 2024
summary: August 2024 Committee on Appointments vetting of 20 Cabinet Secretary nominees: 4 days of public hearings at County Hall (1-4 Aug 2024), the Committee's Second Report tabled and voted in the National Assembly on 7 August 2024 — 19 approved by voice vote ('(Question put and agreed to)'), 1 rejected (Ms Stella Soi Lang'at). No per-MP recorded vote exists for any approval; that absence is rendered as data.
